exposure: Group B Streptococcus (GBS) colonization in late pregnancy
GBS disease in infants from previous pregnancies
outcome: GBS colonization rate in late pregnancy
cohort: The study included 49,908 pregnant women enrolled between April 1, 2014, and March 31, 2017, and their 50,772 neonates.
finding: The GBS colonization rate in late pregnancy was 13.89%, and IAP was found to be effective in protecting against neonatal GBS-EOD.
gest_age: 35-37 weeks of gestation (for GBS colonization screening)
